## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes or adds.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Performance optimization / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added automated unit tests under `tests/` that prove my fix or feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally (`python -m unittest discover tests`).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README where appropriate.
- [ ] No temporary files, binary SQLite databases, or credentials are committed.
